description: This Java class manages WebSocket clients, including registration, message handling, callback management, and cleanup within the mockserver framework.

classes.name: WebSocketClientRegistry
classes.description: Manages WebSocket client connections, message processing, callback registration, and cleanup within the mockserver framework.

methods.name: receivedTextWebSocketFrame
methods.description: Handles incoming WebSocket text frames, deserializes messages, and dispatches to appropriate callbacks based on message type.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of registered WebSocket clients.

methods.name: registerClient
methods.description: Registers a new WebSocket client, sends registration message, and updates metrics.

methods.name: unregisterClient
methods.description: Unregisters a WebSocket client, closes connection, and updates metrics.

methods.name: registerResponseCallbackHandler
methods.description: Registers a response callback handler for a specific WebSocket correlation ID.

methods.name: unregisterResponseCallbackHandler
methods.description: Removes a response callback handler for a specific WebSocket correlation ID.

methods.name: registerForwardCallbackHandler
methods.description: Registers a forward callback handler for a specific WebSocket correlation ID.

methods.name: unregisterForwardCallbackHandler
methods.description: Removes a forward callback handler for a specific WebSocket correlation ID.

methods.name: sendClientMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to a registered WebSocket client, either a request or response, with logging and exception handling.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Clears all callback registries, closes client channels, and resets metrics.
